content:
Robert! Can you come here?
Okay, mom. I'm on my way.
Would you take the trash out, dear?
The can is empty, mom.
No. Not this one. The outside can.
The big can?
Yes. Put it in the street. It's Tuesday.
That's right. Pick-up is tomorrow.
